#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail


codespec_repo="$(pwd)"
codespec_gopath="$(mktemp -d)"
codespec_package="${codespec_gopath}/src/github.com/buildkite/agent"
mkdir -p "${codespec_package}"
for codespec_entry in agent api bootstrap clicommand cliconfig env experiments logger mime pool process proctitle retry signalwatcher stdin system utils main.go; do
  ln -s "${codespec_repo}/${codespec_entry}" "${codespec_package}/${codespec_entry}"
done
cp -a "${codespec_repo}/vendor" "${codespec_package}/vendor"
export GOPATH="${codespec_gopath}"
export GO111MODULE=off
cd "${codespec_package}"
go test ./agent -run '^TestCodespec' -count=1

--- /dev/null
+++ b/usercase-test-coderl/client_announce_lifecycle.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,565 @@
+import test from 'tape'
+import { Client, Server } from '../index.js'
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+const INFO_HASH = '0123456789012345678901234567890123456789'
+const PEER_ID = '1234567890123456789012345678901234567890'
+const ALT_INFO_HASH = 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa'
+const ALT_PEER_ID = 'abcdefabcdefabcdefabcdefabcdefabcdefabcd'
+const PORT = 6881
+
+function createTrackerServer (serverType, opts = {}) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const server = new Server({
+      http: serverType === 'http',
+      udp: serverType === 'udp',
+      ws: serverType === 'ws',
+      stats: false,
+      ...opts
+    })
+    server.once('error', reject)
+    server.on('warning', reject)
+    server.listen(0, () => {
+      const port = server[serverType].address().port
+      const announce = serverType === 'http'
+        ? `http://127.0.0.1:${port}/announce`
+        : serverType === 'udp'
+          ? `udp://127.0.0.1:${port}`
+          : `ws://127.0.0.1:${port}`
+      resolve({ server, announce })
+    })
+  })
+}
+
+function closeServer (server) {
+  return new Promise(resolve => server.close(() => resolve()))
+}
+
+function destroyClient (client) {
+  return new Promise(resolve => client.destroy(() => resolve()))
+}
+
+function wait (ms) {
+  return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms))
+}
+
+function newClient (announce, opts = {}) {
+  return new Client({
+    infoHash: opts.infoHash || INFO_HASH,
+    peerId: opts.peerId || PEER_ID,
+    announce,
+    port: opts.port || PORT,
+    getAnnounceOpts: opts.getAnnounceOpts,
+    wrtc: {}
+  })
+}
+
+function observeClient (t, client, updates) {
+  client.on('update', data => {
+    updates.push({
+      announce: data.announce,
+      complete: data.complete,
+      incomplete: data.incomplete
+    })
+  })
+  client.on('warning', err => {
+    t.fail(`unexpected warning: ${err.message}`)
+  })
+  client.on('error', err => {
+    t.fail(`unexpected error: ${err.message}`)
+  })
+}
+
+async function cleanup (server, client) {
+  if (client && !client.destroyed) await destroyClient(client)
+  if (server && !server.destroyed) await closeServer(server)
+}
+
+test('public Client constructor exposes lifecycle interval control', t => {
+  t.plan(1)
+
+
+
+
+  const client = newClient('http://127.0.0.1:1/announce')
+
+  t.equal(typeof client.setInterval, 'function')
+  client.destroy(() => {})
+})
+
+test('destroy is idempotent when called twice on a started client', async t => {
+  t.plan(2)
+
+
+
+
+  const { server, announce } = await createTrackerServer('http')
+  const client = newClient(announce, {
+    getAnnounceOpts () {
+      return { numwant: 0 }
+    }
+  })
+  const updates = []
+  observeClient(t, client, updates)
+
+  client.setInterval(100)
+  client.start({ left: 11 })
+  await wait(80)
+  await destroyClient(client)
+  t.deepEqual(updates, [
+    { announce, complete: 0, incomplete: 1 }
+  ])
+  await wait(140)
+
+  t.equal(updates.length, 1)
+  await closeServer(server)
+})
+
+test('start schedules protocol default recurring announce cadences', async t => {
+  t.plan(2)
+
+
+
+
+  const http = await createTrackerServer('http')
+  const udp = await createTrackerServer('udp')
+  const ws = await createTrackerServer('ws')
+  const originalSetInterval = globalThis.setInterval
+  const originalClearInterval = globalThis.clearInterval
+  const scheduled = []
+  globalThis.setInterval = (fn, ms, ...args) => {
+    const handle = originalSetInterval(fn, 60 * 60 * 1000, ...args)
+    scheduled.push(ms)
+    return handle
+  }
+  globalThis.clearInterval = handle => originalClearInterval(handle)
+
+  const client = newClient([http.announce, udp.announce, ws.announce], {
+    getAnnounceOpts () {
+      return { numwant: 0 }
+    }
+  })
+  client.on('warning', err => {
+    t.fail(`unexpected warning: ${err.message}`)
+  })
+  client.on('error', err => {
+    t.fail(`unexpected error: ${err.message}`)
+  })
+
+  try {
+    client.start({ numwant: 0, left: 9 })
+
+    t.deepEqual(scheduled.slice(0, 3).sort((a, b) => a - b), [30000, 1800000, 1800000])
+    await destroyClient(client)
+
+    t.equal(scheduled.length, 3)
+  } finally {
+    globalThis.setInterval = originalSetInterval
+    globalThis.clearInterval = originalClearInterval
+    await closeServer(http.server)
+    await closeServer(udp.server)
+    await closeServer(ws.server)
+  }
+})
+
+test('http announce response interval drives recurring announces and refreshes getAnnounceOpts', async t => {
+  t.plan(3)
+
+
+
+
+  const { server, announce } = await createTrackerServer('http', { interval: 1000 })
+  const seenEvents = []
+  const seenLeft = []
+  let left = 99
+  const client = newClient(announce, {
+    getAnnounceOpts () {
+      left += 1
+      return { left }
+    }
+  })
+  const updates = []
+  observeClient(t, client, updates)
+  server.on('start', (peer, params) => {
+    seenEvents.push('started')
+    seenLeft.push(params.left)
+  })
+  server.on('update', (peer, params) => {
+    seenEvents.push('update')
+    seenLeft.push(params.left)
+  })
+
+  client.start()
+  await wait(2250)
+
+
+  t.deepEqual({
+    first: seenEvents[0],
+    total: seenEvents.length,
+    updates: seenEvents.filter(event => event === 'update').length
+  }, { first: 'started', total: 3, updates: 2 })
+  const updateLefts = seenEvents
+    .map((event, index) => event === 'update' ? seenLeft[index] : null)
+    .filter(left => left != null)
+
+  t.ok(updateLefts.length === 2 && updateLefts[1] > updateLefts[0])
+  t.deepEqual(updates, [
+    { announce, complete: 0, incomplete: 1 },
+    { announce, complete: 0, incomplete: 1 },
+    { announce, complete: 0, incomplete: 1 }
+  ])
+
+  await cleanup(server, client)
+})

+package fmtstr_test
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/elastic/beats/v7/libbeat/beat"
+	"github.com/elastic/beats/v7/libbeat/common/fmtstr"
+	"github.com/elastic/elastic-agent-libs/mapstr"
+)
+
+func TestEventModifierFallbackAndAlternate(t *testing.T) {
+	formatter, err := fmtstr.CompileEvent("%{[tenant]:-anonymous}|%{[tenant]:+known}")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Empty(t, formatter.Fields())
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		fields mapstr.M
+		want   string
+	}{
+		{name: "missing", fields: mapstr.M{}, want: "anonymous|"},
+		{name: "empty", fields: mapstr.M{"tenant": ""}, want: "anonymous|"},
+		{name: "present", fields: mapstr.M{"tenant": "acme"}, want: "acme|known"},
+		{name: "false is present", fields: mapstr.M{"tenant": false}, want: "false|known"},
+	}
+	for _, test := range tests {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			got, err := formatter.Run(&beat.Event{Fields: test.fields})
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, test.want, got)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestEventModifierRequiredMessage(t *testing.T) {
+	formatter, err := fmtstr.CompileEvent("route-%{[tenant]:-anonymous}-%{[tenant]:?tenant must be set}")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, []string{"tenant"}, formatter.Fields())
+
+	for _, fields := range []mapstr.M{{}, {"tenant": ""}, {"tenant": []interface{}{"acme"}}} {
+		got, err := formatter.Run(&beat.Event{Fields: fields})
+		require.Error(t, err)
+		require.Contains(t, err.Error(), "tenant must be set")
+		require.Empty(t, got)
+	}
+
+	got, err := formatter.Run(&beat.Event{Fields: mapstr.M{"tenant": "acme"}})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, "route-acme-acme", got)
+}
+
+func TestEventModifiersTreatUnconvertibleValuesAsUnavailable(t *testing.T) {
+	event := &beat.Event{Fields: mapstr.M{"object": []interface{}{1}}}
+
+	fallback, err := fmtstr.CompileEvent("%{[object]:-none}")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	got, err := fallback.Run(event)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, "none", got)
+
+	alternate, err := fmtstr.CompileEvent("%{[object]:+available}")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	got, err = alternate.Run(event)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Empty(t, got)
+}
+
+func TestEventModifierEvaluationAPIsAreConsistentAndAtomic(t *testing.T) {
+	formatter, err := fmtstr.CompileEvent("before-%{[tenant]:?tenant required}-after")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	event := &beat.Event{Fields: mapstr.M{}}
+
+	got, err := formatter.Run(event)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.Empty(t, got)
+
+	gotBytes, err := formatter.RunBytes(event)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.Nil(t, gotBytes)
+
+	buf := bytes.NewBufferString("existing:")
+	err = formatter.Eval(buf, event)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, "existing:", buf.String())
+}
+
+func TestEventModifierValidationAndTimestampCompatibility(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, expression := range []string{
+		"%{[field]:+yes:-fallback}",
+		"%{[field]:!unsupported}",
+		"%{+yyyy.MM.dd:+present}",
+	} {
+		_, err := fmtstr.CompileEvent(expression)
+		require.Error(t, err, expression)
+	}
+
+	formatter, err := fmtstr.CompileEvent("%{+yyyy.MM.dd}")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	got, err := formatter.Run(&beat.Event{Timestamp: time.Date(2024, 2, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, "2024.02.03", got)
+}
+
+func TestLegacyEventFallbackRemainsCompatible(t *testing.T) {
+	formatter, err := fmtstr.CompileEvent("%{[tenant]:legacy}")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Empty(t, formatter.Fields())
+
+	for _, fields := range []mapstr.M{{}, {"tenant": ""}, {"tenant": []interface{}{"acme"}}} {
+		got, err := formatter.Run(&beat.Event{Fields: fields})
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Equal(t, "legacy", got)
+	}
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+
+REPO = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "../.."))
+CONVERTER = os.path.join(REPO, "util/test/convert_start_test_log_to_junit_xml.py")
+
+
+def convert(log_text):
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+        log_path = os.path.join(td, "run.log")
+        xml_path = os.path.join(td, "report.xml")
+        with open(log_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fp:
+            fp.write(log_text)
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, CONVERTER, "--start-test-log", log_path,
+             "--junit-xml", xml_path],
+            cwd=REPO, text=True, capture_output=True
+        )
+        if result.returncode != 0:
+            raise AssertionError(f"converter failed: {result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}")
+        return ET.parse(xml_path).getroot()
+
+
+class JUnitReportContractTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_standalone_test_blocks_and_suite_summary(self):
+        root = convert(
+            "unrelated runner line\n"
+            "[test: smoke/pass.chpl]\n"
+            "[Elapsed time to compile and execute all versions of \"pass\" - 1.25 seconds]\n"
+            "[test: smoke/skip.chpl]\n"
+            "[Skipping because this configuration is unavailable]\n"
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(root.get("tests"), "2")
+        self.assertEqual(root.get("failures"), "0")
+        self.assertEqual(root.get("errors"), "0")
+        self.assertEqual(root.get("skipped"), "1")
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(float(root.get("time")), 1.25)
+
+        cases = root.findall("testcase")
+        self.assertEqual([c.get("classname") for c in cases], ["smoke", "smoke"])
+        self.assertEqual([c.get("name") for c in cases], ["pass", "skip"])
+        self.assertIsNone(cases[0].find("skipped"))
+        self.assertIsNotNone(cases[1].find("skipped"))
+        self.assertIn("Elapsed time", cases[0].find("system-out").text or "")
+
+    def test_errors_are_failures_and_warnings_do_not_fail_cases(self):
+        root = convert(
+            "[Starting subtest - wrapped]\n"
+            "[test: suite/fail.chpl]\n"
+            "[Error: compiler rejected the program]\n"
+            "[Elapsed time to compile and execute all versions of \"fail\" - 0.5 seconds]\n"
+            "[test: suite/warn.chpl]\n"
+            "[Warning: deprecated syntax]\n"
+            "[Elapsed time to compile and execute all versions of \"warn\" - 0.25 seconds]\n"
+            "[Finished subtest \"wrapped\"]\n"
+        )
+
+        self.assertEqual(root.get("tests"), "2")
+        self.assertEqual(root.get("failures"), "1")
+        self.assertEqual(root.get("errors"), "0")
+        self.assertEqual(root.get("skipped"), "0")
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(float(root.get("time")), 0.75)
+
+        failed, warned = root.findall("testcase")
+        failure = failed.find("failure")
+        self.assertIsNotNone(failure)
+        self.assertEqual(failure.get("message"), "Error: compiler rejected the program")
+        self.assertIsNone(failed.find("error"))
+        self.assertIsNone(warned.find("failure"))
+        serialized = ET.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
+        self.assertIn("Warning: deprecated syntax", serialized)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+
+

+        through='codespec.DeconstructThrough',
+        related_name='owners',
+    )
+
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'codespec'

+

+        field = TaggableManager(
+            through='catalog.TaggedProduct',
+            related_name='products_with_tags',
+            blank=True,
+            verbose_name='Labels',
+            help_text='Choose labels',
+        )
+
+        name, path, args, kwargs = field.deconstruct()
+
+        self.assertEqual(path, 'taggit.managers.TaggableManager')
+        self.assertEqual(args, [])
+        self.assertIn('through', kwargs)
+        self.assertIn('related_name', kwargs)
+        self.assertEqual(kwargs['through'], 'catalog.TaggedProduct')
+        self.assertEqual(kwargs['related_name'], 'products_with_tags')
+        self.assertTrue(kwargs['blank'])
+        self.assertEqual(kwargs['verbose_name'], 'Labels')
+        self.assertEqual(kwargs['help_text'], 'Choose labels')
+        self.assertNotIn('serialize', kwargs)
+        self.assertNotIn('null', kwargs)
+
+    def test_deconstruct_keeps_model_label_and_explicit_empty_related_name(self):
+        field = TaggableManager(through=CustomThroughModel, related_name='')
+        kwargs = field.deconstruct()[3]
+
+        self.assertIn('through', kwargs)
+        self.assertIn('related_name', kwargs)
+        self.assertEqual(kwargs['through'], 'codespec.CustomThroughModel')
+        self.assertEqual(kwargs['related_name'], '')
+
+    def test_clone_preserves_relationship_configuration(self):
+        field = TaggableManager(

+            related_name='products_with_tags',

+            verbose_name='Labels',
+            help_text='Choose labels',
+        )
+
+        clone = field.clone()
+
+        self.assertIsNot(clone, field)
+        self.assertEqual(clone.through, 'catalog.TaggedProduct')
+        self.assertEqual(clone.rel.related_name, 'products_with_tags')
+        self.assertTrue(clone.blank)

+import asyncio
+
+from faststream.asgi import AsgiFastStream, AsgiResponse, get
+from faststream.asyncapi.generate import get_app_schema
+
+
+class DummyBroker:
+    url = "memory://broker"
+    protocol = "memory"
+    protocol_version = "1"
+    description = None
+    tags = None
+    security = None
+    _subscribers = {}
+    _publishers = {}
+
+    def setup(self):
+        pass
+
+
+def build_metadata_app():
+    try:
+        readiness_decorator = get(
+            description="Readiness endpoint",
+            operation_id="readiness",
+            tags=("ops", "health"),
+        )
+    except TypeError as exc:
+        raise AssertionError(
+            "get() must expose operation_id and tags metadata options"
+        ) from exc
+
+    @readiness_decorator
+    async def readiness(scope):
+        return AsgiResponse(b"ready", 200)
+
+    @get
+    async def documented_by_docstring(scope):
+
+        return AsgiResponse(b"docs", 200)
+
+    return AsgiFastStream(
+        DummyBroker(),
+        asgi_routes=[("/ready", readiness), ("/docstring", documented_by_docstring)],
+    )
+
+
+def build_runtime_app():
+    @get(include_in_schema=False)
+    async def internal(scope):
+        return AsgiResponse(b"internal", 200)
+
+    return AsgiFastStream(
+        DummyBroker(),
+        asgi_routes=[("/internal", internal)],
+    )
+
+
+def test_included_routes_have_http_operations_and_metadata():
+    schema = get_app_schema(build_metadata_app()).to_jsonable()
+    channels = schema["channels"]
+
+    assert set(channels) == {"/ready", "/docstring"}
+
+    ready = channels["/ready"]["publish"]
+    assert ready["operationId"] == "readiness"
+    assert ready["description"] == "Readiness endpoint"
+    assert [tag["name"] for tag in ready["tags"]] == ["ops", "health"]
+    assert ready["bindings"]["http"]["method"] == "GET"
+
+    docstring = channels["/docstring"]["publish"]
+    assert docstring["operationId"] == "documented_by_docstring"
+    assert docstring["description"] == "Serves the documented fallback."
+
+
+def test_schema_does_not_expose_opted_out_route_but_runtime_still_serves_it():
+    app = build_runtime_app()
+    events = []
+
+    async def receive():
+        return {"type": "http.request"}
+
+    async def send(message):
+        events.append(message)
+
+    async def exercise():
+        await app(
+            {"type": "http", "path": "/internal", "method": "GET"},
+            receive,
+            send,
+        )
+
+    asyncio.run(exercise())
+    assert events[0]["status"] == 200
+    assert events[1]["body"] == b"internal"
+    assert "/internal" not in get_app_schema(app).to_jsonable()["channels"]
+
+
+def test_non_get_requests_keep_existing_method_not_allowed_behavior():
+    app = build_runtime_app()
+    events = []
+
+    async def receive():
+        return {"type": "http.request"}
+
+    async def send(message):
+        events.append(message)
+
+    async def exercise():
+        await app(
+            {"type": "http", "path": "/internal", "method": "POST"},
+            receive,
+            send,
+        )
+
+    asyncio.run(exercise())
+    assert events[0]["status"] == 405
+    assert dict(events[0]["headers"])[b"allow"] == b"GET, HEAD"

+	t.Helper()

+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("test fixture hex must decode: %v", err)
+	}
+	return data
+}
+
+func assertHex(t *testing.T, got []byte, want string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if hex.EncodeToString(got) != want {
+		t.Fatalf("hex output = %s, want %s", hex.EncodeToString(got), want)
+	}
+}
+
+func assertBeaconFields(t *testing.T, got waclib.WACBeacon, mac [6]byte, flags []byte, name string, supplier string, typ string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if got.MACAddress != mac {
+		t.Fatalf("MACAddress = %x, want %x", got.MACAddress, mac)
+	}
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got.Flags, flags) {
+		t.Fatalf("Flags = %x, want %x", got.Flags, flags)
+	}
+	if got.Name != name {
+		t.Fatalf("Name = %q, want %q", got.Name, name)
+	}
+	if got.Supplier != supplier {
+		t.Fatalf("Supplier = %q, want %q", got.Supplier, supplier)
+	}
+	if got.Type != typ {
+		t.Fatalf("Type = %q, want %q", got.Type, typ)
+	}
+}
+
+func assertErrorMessage(t *testing.T, err error, message string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if err == nil {
+		t.Fatalf("error = <nil>, want message %q", message)
+	}
+
+	if err.Error() != message {
+		t.Fatalf("error message = %q, want %q", err.Error(), message)
+	}
+}
+
+func openFDCount(t *testing.T) int {

+import asyncio
+import importlib
+import json
+import os
+import threading
+import time
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
+
+import pytest
+
+from ollama import AsyncClient, Client, ResponseError
+
+
+
+
+
+
+class _Route:
+  def __init__(self, chunks=None, status=200, body='', close=False):
+    self.chunks = chunks or []
+    self.status = status
+    self.body = body
+    self.close = close
+
+
+class _State:
+  def __init__(self):
+    self.routes = {}
+    self.requests = []
+    self.active_connections = 0
+    self.lock = threading.Lock()
+
+
+class _ThreadingServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
+  daemon_threads = True
+
+
+class _StreamingHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+  protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'
+
+  def setup(self):
+    super().setup()
+    with self.server.state.lock:
+      self.server.state.active_connections += 1
+
+  def finish(self):
+    try:
+      super().finish()
+    finally:
+      with self.server.state.lock:
+        self.server.state.active_connections -= 1
+
+  def log_message(self, *_):
+    pass
+
+  def do_POST(self):
+    length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', '0'))
+    body = self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')
+    payload = json.loads(body) if body else {}
+    with self.server.state.lock:
+      self.server.state.requests.append((self.path, payload))
+
+    route = self.server.state.routes.get(self.path)
+    if route is None:
+      data = b'no route configured'
+      self.send_response(500)
+      self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
+      self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
+      self.end_headers()
+      self.wfile.write(data)
+      return
+
+    if route.status != 200:
+      data = route.body.encode('utf-8')
+      self.send_response(route.status)
+      self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/plain')
+      self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
+      if route.close:
+        self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
+        self.close_connection = True
+      self.end_headers()
+      self.wfile.write(data)
+      return
+
+    self.send_response(200)
+    self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/x-ndjson')
+    self.send_header('Transfer-Encoding', 'chunked')
+    if route.close:
+      self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
+      self.close_connection = True
+    self.end_headers()
+    for chunk in route.chunks:
+      line = (json.dumps(chunk) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
+      self.wfile.write(f'{len(line):x}\r\n'.encode('ascii'))
+      self.wfile.write(line)
+      self.wfile.write(b'\r\n')
+      self.wfile.flush()
+    self.wfile.write(b'0\r\n\r\n')
+    self.wfile.flush()
+
+
+class StreamingServer:
+  def __init__(self):
+    self.state = _State()
+    self.server = _ThreadingServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), _StreamingHandler)
+    self.server.state = self.state
+    self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+
+  def __enter__(self):
+    self.thread.start()
+    return self
+
+  def __exit__(self, *_):
+    self.server.shutdown()
+    self.server.server_close()
+
+  @property
+  def url(self):
+    host, port = self.server.server_address
+    return f'http://{host}:{port}'
+
+  def stream(self, path, chunks, *, close=False):
+    self.state.routes[path] = _Route(chunks=chunks, close=close)
+
+  def error(self, path, status, body):
+    self.state.routes[path] = _Route(status=status, body=body)
+
+  def requests(self):
+    with self.state.lock:
+      return list(self.state.requests)
+
+  def active_connections(self):
+    with self.state.lock:
+      return self.state.active_connections
+
+  def wait_for_active_at_most(self, limit):
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 2
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+      if self.active_connections() <= limit:
+        return self.active_connections()
+      time.sleep(0.01)
+    return self.active_connections()
+
+
+def _dump_parts(parts):
+  return [part.model_dump(exclude_none=True) for part in parts]
+
+
+async def _dump_async_parts(parts):
+  dumped = []
+  async for part in parts:
+    dumped.append(part.model_dump(exclude_none=True))
+  return dumped
+
+
+def _assert_stream_requests(actual, expected):
+  assert len(actual) >= len(expected)
+  for _, payload in actual:
+    assert payload.get('stream') is True
+
+  remaining = iter(actual)
+  for expected_path, expected_payload in expected:
+
+    for actual_path, actual_payload in remaining:
+      if actual_path == expected_path and all(actual_payload.get(key) == value for key, value in expected_payload.items()):

+package endpoints_test
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stackrox/rox/pkg/endpoints"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+type endpointLeaf struct {
+	Endpoint string `validate:"nolocalendpoint"`
+}
+
+type endpointTree struct {
+	Direct   string `validate:"nolocalendpoint"`
+	Child    *endpointLeaf
+	Leaves   []endpointLeaf
+	Array    [1]endpointLeaf
+	ByName   map[string]endpointLeaf
+	Dynamic  interface{}
+	Optional *endpointLeaf
+	Untagged string
+}
+
+func TestValidateEndpointsCanonicalLocalAddressForms(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	blocked := []string{
+		"LOCALHOST:8443",
+		"localhost.",
+		"localhost..",
+		"metadata.google.internal.",
+		"METADATA.GOOGLE.INTERNAL:443",
+		"127.0.0.42:8080",
+		"127.255.255.254:8080",
+		"169.254.10.10:80",
+		"169.254.255.254:80",
+		"[::1]:443",
+		"[fe80::1]:443",
+		"[febf:ffff::1]:443",
+	}
+	for _, endpoint := range blocked {
+		t.Run(endpoint, func(t *testing.T) {
+			err := endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&endpointLeaf{Endpoint: endpoint})
+			require.Error(t, err)
+		})
+	}
+
+	allowed := []string{
+		"localhost.example",
+		"127.0.0.1.example",
+		"169.254.169.254.example",
+		"126.255.255.255:443",
+		"128.0.0.1:443",
+		"169.253.255.255:443",
+		"169.255.0.1:443",
+		"10.0.0.1:443",
+		"[fe7f:ffff::1]:443",
+		"[fec0::1]:443",
+		"[2001:db8::1]:443",
+	}
+	for _, endpoint := range allowed {
+		t.Run("allowed_"+endpoint, func(t *testing.T) {
+			assert.NoError(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&endpointLeaf{Endpoint: endpoint}))
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestValidateEndpointsHandlesSchemesAndMalformedURLs(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	assert.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&endpointLeaf{Endpoint: "HTTP://LOCALHOST:443"}))
+	assert.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&endpointLeaf{Endpoint: "https://[::1]:443"}))
+	assert.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&endpointLeaf{Endpoint: "http://user:pass@127.0.0.2/path"}))
+	assert.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&endpointLeaf{Endpoint: "http://[::1"}))
+	assert.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&endpointLeaf{Endpoint: "http://bad%2ghost"}))
+	assert.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&endpointLeaf{Endpoint: "http://"}))
+	assert.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&endpointLeaf{Endpoint: "ftp://example.com"}))
+	assert.NoError(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&endpointLeaf{Endpoint: "https://example.com/localhost"}))
+}
+
+func TestValidateEndpointsTraversesContainersAndPreservesNilEmptyValues(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	t.Run("nil pointers and empty endpoints", func(t *testing.T) {
+		base := endpointTree{Direct: "", Optional: nil, Untagged: "localhost"}
+		assert.NoError(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&base))
+		assert.NoError(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints((*endpointTree)(nil)))
+	})
+
+	t.Run("slice field", func(t *testing.T) {
+		base := endpointTree{Leaves: []endpointLeaf{{Endpoint: "https://localhost:443"}}}
+		require.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&base))
+	})
+
+	t.Run("array field", func(t *testing.T) {
+		base := endpointTree{Array: [1]endpointLeaf{{Endpoint: "https://[::1]:443"}}}
+		require.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&base))
+	})
+
+	t.Run("map field", func(t *testing.T) {
+		base := endpointTree{ByName: map[string]endpointLeaf{"metadata": {Endpoint: "169.254.1.1:80"}}}
+		require.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&base))
+	})
+
+	t.Run("interface and pointer fields", func(t *testing.T) {
+		base := endpointTree{Dynamic: &endpointLeaf{Endpoint: "localhost"}}
+		require.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(&base))
+	})
+
+	t.Run("top-level containers", func(t *testing.T) {
+		require.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints([]endpointLeaf{{Endpoint: "localhost"}}))
+		require.Error(t, endpoints.ValidateEndpoints(map[string]endpointLeaf{"local": {Endpoint: "127.1.2.3"}}))
+	})
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env python
+from __future__ import unicode_literals
+

+

+

+from youtube_dlc.utils import OnDemandPagedList
+
+ytdl_mod = importlib.import_module('youtube_dlc.YoutubeDL')
+
+
+def video_entry(idx):
+    return {
+        'id': 'v%s' % idx,
+        'title': 'Video %s' % idx,
+        'url': 'http://media.example.invalid/video%s.mp4' % idx,
+        'ext': 'mp4',
+    }
+
+
+class OfflineListIE(InfoExtractor):
+    IE_NAME = 'offline:list'
+    _VALID_URL = r'offline:list$'
+
+    def _real_extract(self, url):
+        return {
+            '_type': 'playlist',
+            'id': 'loaded',
+            'title': 'Loaded Fixture',
+            'entries': [video_entry(i) for i in range(1, 5)],
+            'extractor': self.IE_NAME,
+            'extractor_key': self.ie_key(),
+            'webpage_url': url,
+        }
+
+
+class OfflinePagedIE(InfoExtractor):
+    IE_NAME = 'offline:paged'
+    _VALID_URL = r'offline:paged$'
+
+    def _real_extract(self, url):
+        def pagefunc(page_num):
+            start = page_num * 2 + 1
+            if start > 4:
+                return []
+            return [video_entry(i) for i in range(start, min(start + 2, 5))]
+
+        return {
+            '_type': 'playlist',
+            'id': 'paged',
+            'title': 'Paged Fixture',
+            'entries': OnDemandPagedList(pagefunc, 2),
+            'extractor': self.IE_NAME,
+            'extractor_key': self.ie_key(),
+            'webpage_url': url,
+        }
+
+
+class OfflineIterableIE(InfoExtractor):
+    IE_NAME = 'offline:iterable'
+    _VALID_URL = r'offline:iterable$'
+
+    def _real_extract(self, url):
+        def entries():
+            for i in range(1, 5):
+                yield video_entry(i)
+
+        return {
+            '_type': 'playlist',
+            'id': 'iterable',
+            'title': 'Iterable Fixture',
+            'entries': entries(),
+            'extractor': self.IE_NAME,
+            'extractor_key': self.ie_key(),
+            'webpage_url': url,
+        }
+
+
+ytdl_mod.gen_extractor_classes = lambda: [OfflineListIE(), OfflinePagedIE(), OfflineIterableIE()]
+youtube_dlc.main(sys.argv[1:])
